title: [Photo] Samsung manager Park Jin-man trusts Choi Hyoung-woo
text:

 2026년 11월 3일(화) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Sports Photos [Photo] Samsung manager Park Jin-man trusts Choi Hyoung-woo 
 입력 2026.11.03. 18:40 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 
 On the 3rd at Suwon KT Wiz Park, Game 1 of the 2026 Shinhan SOL KBO Korean Series between the KT Wiz and the Samsung Lions was held.
 It is a matchup between KT, which is aiming for a combined championship for the first time in five years since the 2021 season combined title, and Samsung, which returned to the Korean Series stage for the first time in two years since the 2024 season. On this day, KT started Daniel, and Samsung started Choi Won-tae.
 Before the game, Samsung manager Park Jin-man and Choi Hyoung-woo exchanged greetings. Nov. 3, 2026
